facebook.long_about:
West Apadana is an independent digital design studio. We design premium websites and distinctive digital experiences for businesses that want their first impression to match the quality of their work.

What we share: lessons on websites, branding and conversion, written for business owners and made to be used the same day.

What we show: concept projects. Our portfolio pieces are concepts we designed ourselves, not client work, and we label them that way every time.

Ways to start:
- Homepage review (free): a concise review of your homepage that names three improvements.
- Website improvement assessment (free): an initial look at what could be improved on your site. It is an assessment, not a promise of a redesign.
- Project conversation: tell us about a website you are considering and we will talk it through.

Every inquiry is handled personally by the founder.
facebook.keyword_placement: Page name suffix, intro and the first sentence of the description are what Facebook search reads. Category: pick the closest web or design option.
facebook.cta: Action button: 'Send message' (owner handles) or 'Learn more' to the inquiry page. Prefer whichever the owner can answer personally.
facebook.link_strategy: Website field plus the action button both go to the inquiry destination. Messenger is optional; if enabled, Facebook may show its own average-response badge. We cannot control that, and no response time is promised in copy.
facebook.photo: Same profile mark as Instagram. Facebook displays it small (about 170 px on desktop) and circular.
facebook.banner: Cover about 820x312 on desktop and 640x360 on phones. Design a 1640x624 source with all text inside the central 640x312 safe zone. Verify the current crop in the editor.
extras: Username/URL: facebook.com/thewestapadana if available.
Hours: leave unset unless the owner chooses to publish them.
Add the website, public email only if approved.
Pin the first lesson post once published.
Link the Page to the Instagram professional account.
